applicabilityBasis.summary: Etherfuse CETES is a NAV-accruing tokenized claim backed by Mexican federal CETES Treasury bonds, priced in MXN at an appreciating net asset value rather than maintained or redeemable at a fixed monetary value of national currency. Because it is not designed to maintain a stable fixed value for payment or settlement under GENIUS Act section 2(22)(A), it falls outside the GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization regime. Etherfuse also restricts primary onboarding to KYC-verified non-U.S. persons.

genius.notes: Etherfuse MX, S.A. de C.V. (operating with Etherfuse Liquid Mx, S.A.P.I. de C.V.) issues CETES as a NAV-accruing tokenized Mexican sovereign-bond claim backed by CETES held in segregated Mexican brokerage accounts via INDEVAL. Because CETES accrues yield in NAV rather than promising fixed 1:1 national-currency redemption, it is classified as non-payment-token for GENIUS tracking without asserting a U.S. securities-law determination. Monthly BHR México reasonable-assurance examinations reconcile total CETES tokens in circulation against brokerage custody balances; redemptionPolicyPresent remains false because the tracker reserves that flag for a fixed 1:1 payment-stablecoin redemption policy. MiCA status remains unassessed pending primary EU/EEA legal or offering documentation.
